title: Game of life step
statementMd:
Apply one step of Conway's Game of Life on a finite board (cells outside are dead): a live cell with 2 or 3 live neighbours survives; a dead cell with exactly 3 live neighbours becomes live; all others are dead. Return the new board.

**Example:** `life_step([[0, 1, 0], [0, 1, 0], [0, 1, 0]])` returns `[[0, 0, 0], [1, 1, 1], [0, 0, 0]]`.
hints: Count the 8 neighbours from the original board.
